text: “Be silent before me, you islands! Let the nations renew their strength! Let them come forward and speak; let us meet together at the place of judgment.

Jacob, whom I have chosen, you descendants of Abraham my friend,
from its farthest corners I called you. I said, ‘You are my servant’; I have chosen you and have not rejected you.

so we may know that you are gods. Do something, whether good or bad, so that we will be dismayed and filled with fear.
